title.zh: 同步新版运行时与工作台体验优化
title.en: Updated runtime and refined workspace experience

zh: 长期记忆列表支持分页，沿用折叠详情与删除确认。
主任务、子任务与上下文维护对齐 Desktop 的用量配置，子任务单次执行上限为四小时。
en: Page through saved memories with expandable details and deletion confirmation.
Align parent, child and context-maintenance usage settings with Desktop and allow child runs up to four hours.

zh: 升级至 Platform v0.6.107（Velaros 0.6.33）与 UI 0.2.73，统一消费合并后的正式运行时包。
同步共享聊天时间线、通信消息、工具卡与子任务历史恢复修复。
缓存会话用量的持久化结果，减少流式更新时的重复处理。
优化编辑器标签关闭按钮、终端滚动条及 Windows 窗口标题。
修复终端交互与进程树清理，保留失败诊断并避免无效 PID 影响系统进程。
en: Upgrade to Platform v0.6.107 (Velaros 0.6.33) and UI 0.2.73 using the consolidated published runtime.
Integrate shared timeline, communication, tool-card and child-task history recovery fixes.
Reuse persisted usage telemetry while streaming to reduce repeated serialization.
Refine editor tab close buttons, terminal scrollbars and Windows window titles.
Improve terminal interaction and process cleanup, preserve failure diagnostics and reject invalid process IDs.

title.zh: 稳定任务恢复与准确执行状态
title.en: Reliable task recovery and accurate execution status

zh: 修复子任务冷恢复后显示旧摘要、重复执行卡及历史事件发送失败后漏发的问题。
完善账户续期与模型目录恢复，保留安全的会话边界，并展示可操作的加载错误。
优化工具详情展开和代码高亮，按真实开始时间计时，准确显示缓存命中及统计覆盖范围。
修复 Windows 终端参数传递与浏览器截图视口问题；固定依赖归档按内容校验和隔离，避免复用旧包缓存。
en: Fix stale child-task summaries after cold recovery, duplicate execution cards, and lost history events after failed delivery.
Improve account renewal and model-catalog recovery while preserving session boundaries and showing actionable loading errors.
Improve tool-detail responsiveness and syntax highlighting, preserve actual execution start times, and report cache hit rate with measurement coverage.
Fix Windows terminal argument handling and browser screenshot viewports; isolate pinned archives by content checksum to prevent stale package-cache reuse.

title.zh: 任务恢复与紧凑用量展示
title.en: Task recovery and compact usage summary

zh: 支持管理常驻服务，恢复任务事件并汇总主、子 Agent 用量。
新增共享用量浮卡，以小字号和主题色进度条显示输入、输出与缓存命中。
en: Manage persistent services, recover task events, and aggregate parent and child agent usage.
Add a shared compact usage card with input, output, and a theme-colored cache hit bar.

zh: 升级固定 Platform 与 UI 快照，完善真实项目任务的编辑器同步和运行兼容。
子 Agent 展示模型名称和任务标题，长文本省略；思考及工具活动默认折叠并保留用户展开选择。
停止 Windows 调试和终端任务时，先记录实际子进程，再逐层结束，避免残留进程占用项目目录。
en: Update pinned Platform and UI snapshots and improve editor synchronization and runtime compatibility for real project tasks.
Show model names and task titles on child agents with overflow ellipsis; collapse thinking and tool activity by default while retaining user choices.
Capture and terminate actual Windows child processes before closing their shell, preventing orphaned tasks from locking project folders.

title.zh: 共享运行时更新
title.en: Shared runtime update

zh: 同步最新 Platform v0.6.62 固定依赖快照，升级 Velaros 运行时至 0.6.4。
将内置 Node 升级到 24.22.0 LTS，开发工具链统一使用 Bun 1.4.3。
en: Update to the pinned Platform v0.6.62 dependency snapshot with Velaros runtime 0.6.4.
Upgrade bundled Node to 24.22.0 LTS and align the development toolchain on Bun 1.4.3.

title.zh: 任务验证指导更新
title.en: Task verification guidance

zh: 完善编码任务的验证指导，核对默认测试的发现范围、最终产物入口和已有调用方兼容性，并补验后续修改。
en: Clarify coding-task guidance for test discovery, final delivery entry points, existing consumer compatibility, and revalidation after later edits.

title.zh: 共享运行时升级
title.en: Shared runtime upgrade

zh: 升级到最新共享运行时，改进长任务的上下文管理、完成检查和中断恢复。
保留执行证据与工具结果，改进模型流中断的处理与后续任务恢复。
en: Upgrade the shared runtime for improved long-task context management, completion checks, and interruption recovery.
Retain execution evidence and tool results, with improved handling of interrupted model streams and resumed tasks.

title.zh: 运行时与应用更新修复
title.en: Runtime and application update fixes

zh: Windows 更新先校验并解压程序包，退出后直接替换程序文件，重启生效。
替换失败自动恢复旧程序，保留会话、设置和卸载入口。
修复更新目录校验失败，并显示检查或下载失败的具体原因。
同步最新 Platform 运行时与能力合同。
修复 Linux 调试结束时 Node 进程偶发崩溃的问题。
en: Verify and extract Windows application updates, then replace application files after exit and restart.
Restore the previous application if replacement fails, preserving conversations, settings, and the uninstaller.
Correct update catalog validation and show the reason when update checks or downloads fail.
Adopt the latest Platform runtime and capability contracts.
Prevent intermittent Node process crashes when debugging finishes on Linux.

title.zh: 消息排队与编辑体验更新
title.en: Message queue and editing improvements

zh: 运行中发送消息默认进入队列，点击队列项发送可立即引导当前任务。
排队消息可原地编辑，回车保存；出错或停止后保留队列，等待手动发送。
收紧队列间距，精简引导状态；复制按钮与时间悬浮显示，保持消息位置。
修复 Windows 终端进程退出时的异常。
修复 Windows 路径下 Skill 合同编译失败的问题，支持包含中文和空格的项目目录。
修复 Windows 编辑器未保存内容的类型分析、命令引号及终端进程退出处理。
修复 Windows 引用预览和 Claude Code 启动参数，改进长文件的调试变量提示。
完善 Windows 原生终端依赖和安装包校验。
en: Messages sent during a run enter the queue; send a queued item to guide the active task immediately.
Edit queued messages in place and press Enter to save. Failed or stopped runs retain queued messages for manual delivery.
Tighten queue spacing and guidance labels; show copy actions and timestamps as overlays without shifting messages.
Fix an exception when closing terminal processes on Windows.
Fix Skill contract compilation on Windows, including project paths containing spaces and non-ASCII characters.
Correct TypeScript analysis of unsaved Windows editor buffers, shell quoting, and terminal process shutdown.
Fix Windows reference previews and Claude Code launch arguments, and improve debug hover values in long files.
Correct Windows native terminal dependencies and packaged application validation.

title.zh: 项目编辑与 Agent 协作统一升级
title.en: A unified update to project editing and Agent collaboration

zh: 在聊天输入框直接选择提供方的可用模型；Claude Code 与 Codex 使用各自的侧栏入口和会话。
Agent 后台进程在独立控制台窗口中查看和操作。
与 Desktop 使用一致的上下文容量校准，执行期间保留用量显示。
en: Choose available provider models directly in the chat composer, with dedicated sidebar entries and sessions for Claude Code and Codex.
Inspect and control Agent background processes in a dedicated console window.
Use the same context-capacity calibration as Desktop and retain usage during execution.

zh: 普通消息正确区分运行中追加指引；执行卡片持续显示耗时，输出预览更清晰。
精简 Git 分支菜单，将拉取和推送放在分支行内，获取远端保留在搜索框旁。
统一聊天栏高度、按钮位置和面板间距，整理组件目录与样式资源。
en: Distinguish ordinary messages from guidance added during a run, show live execution duration, and clarify output previews.
Simplify the Git branch menu with inline pull and push actions and fetch beside branch search.
Align chat headers, action placement and panel spacing, and organize component and style resources.

title.zh: 更清楚的 AI 项目工具，整组修改可以检查和撤销
title.en: Clearer AI project tools, with batch changes you can inspect and undo

zh: 文件管理、内容编辑和整组改动有各自的工具。AI 可以组合行范围与原文定位修改，读到的源码和行位置分别呈现，减少定位歧义。
修改后自动更新 AI 使用的文件版本，历史源码可以按需召回；失败的编辑可以沿用已有正文，只补充需要修正的参数。
符号、引用、依赖与影响范围按需查询，查询结果会说明覆盖范围；整组改动可以检查后撤销。
AI 可以按需把多个文件统一转换为指定编码和换行（默认 UTF-8、无 BOM、LF），正文不变，整组转换可以撤销；读取过大批量文件时不再丢失部分源码。
en: File management, content edits and batch changes have dedicated tools. The AI can combine line ranges with source text to locate edits, while reads keep source text and line positions separate.
Edits refresh the file version available to the AI, and earlier source versions can be recalled. Failed edits can reuse their original content with only the corrected arguments supplied.
Symbols, references, dependencies and impact can be queried on demand with explicit coverage. Batch changes can be inspected and undone.

The AI can convert many files to a chosen encoding and line ending on request (UTF-8 without BOM and LF by default) with the text unchanged, and the whole batch can be undone. Large batch reads no longer lose part of the source.

zh: 编辑范围校验、失败重试和旧会话恢复统一检查当前文件，批量修改在校验失败时保持文件原样，并保留编码、换行与权限。
依赖查询会直接展示各方向支持的参数，减少把「谁依赖它」和「它依赖谁」的筛选条件混用导致的失败。
命令执行会识别项目路径的系统别名，并向 AI 提供当前系统和 Shell 信息；没有窗口的任务按实际可用能力发现工具。
切换计划或目标模式后，Claude 和 ChatGPT 会按当前模式继续任务；只读子任务的工具说明与实际权限保持一致。
更新安装器在发现可安装版本时才加载，减少应用启动时加载的代码。
en: Edit validation, retries and restored sessions check the current file consistently. Validation failures leave batch targets unchanged, preserving encoding, line endings and permissions.
Dependency queries expose the fields supported by each direction, reducing failures from mixing incoming and outgoing filters.
Commands recognize system aliases of the project path and provide the AI with the current system and shell. Headless tasks discover tools according to the capabilities available to them.
Claude and ChatGPT resume with the current plan and goal modes. Read-only task guidance stays aligned with the tools actually available.
The update installer loads when an installable version is found, reducing code loaded at startup.

title.zh: AI 改文件更稳，失败的编辑能原样重试，欢迎页和工具行更清楚
title.en: Steadier AI file edits, failed edits that can be retried as they were, and a clearer welcome page and tool rows

zh: AI 可以按行号改文件：读文件时自动带上行号，改动绑定读到的文件版本，文件在别处被改过会先要求重读，不会改错位置。
工具调用的原始参数和结果保存到磁盘。历史被压缩或重启应用之后，AI 仍能取回之前失败编辑的完整内容，修正后直接重试，不必重新生成。
en: The AI can edit files by line number: reads show line numbers, and each edit is tied to the version it read, so a file changed elsewhere is re-read first instead of being edited in the wrong place.
Tool call arguments and results are saved to disk. After history compaction or a restart, the AI can still recover a failed edit's full input, fix it and retry instead of generating it again.

zh: 欢迎页左侧内容改为居中；最近项目列表不再无限变长，超过上限后在列表里滚动。
工具行的悬停气泡重新带上指向工具行的小箭头；和工具行内容完全一样的气泡不再弹出；计划、目标、浏览器等工具行补上了具体在做什么。
重命名、删除或回滚后重建的文件保留原来的权限（例如可执行脚本）和编码（例如 UTF-16）。
一批改动失败并恢复之后，可以直接重试，不再因为文件版本过期被拒。
命令输出中的中文等多字节字符不再被拆成乱码，标准错误里的诊断信息也会完整保留。
AI 在项目以外的目录执行命令时，会明确提示超出当前项目并给出建议，不再只报未知错误。
失败的编辑卡片不再显示「未知文件」。
en: The welcome page's left column is centered, and the recent projects list stops growing and scrolls within a capped height.
Tool row bubbles point at their row again, bubbles that only repeat the row no longer open, and plan, goal, browser and other tool rows now say what they acted on.
Files recreated by a rename, delete or rollback keep their permissions (such as executable scripts) and encoding (such as UTF-16).
After a failed batch of changes is recovered, it can be retried without being rejected as out of date.
Command output no longer garbles multi-byte characters such as Chinese, and diagnostics printed to stderr are kept in full.
Running a command in a directory outside the project now says it is outside the current project and suggests what to do, instead of reporting an unknown error.
Failed edit cards no longer show an unknown file.

title.zh: 点过的按钮会收起，键盘焦点看得见，会话改动带着编辑区一起切
title.en: Hover buttons that go away after a click, visible keyboard focus, and Session Changes that opens its diffs

zh: 悬停才出现的按钮（比如改动卡片文件行的「打开文件」）点过之后一直留在那里；现在鼠标移开就收起，用 Tab 键走到行上时照样显示。消息下方的操作栏、工具行、最近项目、标签列表等同样修正。
输入框工具栏、模型选择和文件改动卡片里的按钮用 Tab 键聚焦时看不到焦点框。
点左侧「会话改动」后编辑区还停在原来的文件；现在会带回打开过的改动对比，没打开过就打开最新一轮改过的文件。
回溯确认框里「保留这 N 个文件」没算上 AI 用命令改的文件，和改动卡片对不上。
聊天右侧的滚动导航一直压着正文；现在默认收起，点标题栏的「滚动导航」按钮才显示。
顶栏的运行按钮恢复绿色。
en: Buttons that appear on hover, such as Open file in a changes card row, stayed visible after a click; they now hide when the pointer leaves and still show when you Tab to the row. Message action bars, tool rows, recent projects and the tab list behave the same way.
The composer toolbar, model picker and file change card buttons showed no focus ring when reached with Tab.
Opening Session Changes from the left rail left the editor on the previous file; it now brings back open change tabs, or opens the newest round's files when none are open.
The rewind dialog's file count left out files the AI changed through commands, so it did not match the changes card.
The scroll navigator sat over the chat all the time; it now starts hidden and the Scroll navigation button in the chat header shows it.
The run button in the top bar is green again.

title.zh: 「本轮改动」只算 AI 的，回溯不再撤掉你自己的修改
title.en: Round changes count only the AI's edits, and rewind keeps yours

zh: 「本轮改动」卡片和 AI 改动面板把运行期间你在编辑器里保存的、终端或别的程序改的、别的会话写的文件也算成 AI 的；现在只列 AI 改过的文件（含它跑的命令生成的），两边都改过的注明「含 AI 之外的改动」。
回溯并选择同时回退文件时，会把整个项目恢复到那一刻，连你自己的修改一起撤掉；现在只撤回 AI 改过、之后没人再动过的文件，两边都改过或事后又改过的保留原样，并在回溯说明里列出。这个版本之前的旧会话仍按原方式整体还原。
共享组件的样式此前被加载顺序压住：深色主题下 Quick Open、菜单和对话框还是浅色的，点中的搜索结果没有选中底色，错误提示文字不是红色；现在都按设计显示，输入框工具栏等共享组件也与 Desktop 一致。
全屏时设置页标题左侧和文件历史的头部还留着红绿灯的空位。
en: The round changes card and the AI changes panel counted files you saved in the editor, changed in a terminal or another program, or that another conversation wrote during a run, as the AI's. They now list only the files the AI changed, including output of its commands, and mark files also edited outside the AI.

Rewinding with files restored the whole project to that point and reverted your own edits too. It now undoes only files the AI changed that nobody touched since; files edited on both sides or afterwards are kept and listed in the rewind note. Conversations from earlier versions still restore the whole project.

Load order let older Workbench rules override the shared component styles: in the dark theme Quick Open, menus and dialogs stayed light, a clicked search result showed no selection, and error text was not red. They now look as designed, and shared parts such as the composer toolbar match Desktop.
In full screen, the settings title and the file history header still left a gap for the window buttons.

title.zh: 文件一键加进聊天，拖分栏不再卡，工具气泡说清做了什么
title.en: Add files to the chat, smooth pane resizing, and tool bubbles that say what ran

zh: 编辑器、标签页和文件树的右键菜单新增「添加到聊天」：文件以 chip 挂到输入框，可以一次挂多个（文件树多选后右键就是「添加 N 个文件到聊天」）。发出去的只是文件路径，AI 自己按需去读，不会把内容塞进消息；在输入框里敲 @ 还能重新选本会话挂过的文件。
工具调用行悬停时弹出详情气泡：写明实际执行的操作（例如 append、find_references、replace_text）和对象，归并的 ×N 行逐次列出每次调用的命令与耗时；气泡与行等宽、可以移进去选中文字。
子 Agent 可以跨轮续跑：主 Agent 用上次返回的 thread_id 接着使用同一个子 Agent（它保留着读过的上下文），追问、补做、修复后复验不再从头重读；需要独立复核时才新派。
en: Right-click "Add to Chat" in the editor, on a tab or in the file tree attaches files to the chat box, several at once (a multi-selection in the file tree adds them all). Only the paths are sent and the AI reads what it needs itself; typing @ re-picks files referenced earlier in the session.

Hovering a tool call row opens a detail bubble that names the operation that actually ran (for example append, find_references, replace_text) and its target; merged ×N rows list each call with its command and duration. The bubble is as wide as the row and you can move into it to select text.

Sub-agents can be continued across turns: the main agent reuses a sub-agent through the thread_id it returned, keeping everything it already read, so follow-ups, fixes and re-checks no longer start from scratch; a fresh sub-agent is only started when an independent review is needed.

zh: 拖动左右分栏和底部面板的分隔条时很卡，聊天记录越长越卡，AI 运行中尤其明显；三条分隔条的抓手和高亮线也统一了粗细。
回答末尾的费用估算只按可见的问答文字算，一次上百轮、带子 Agent 的执行只显示几毛钱；现在按整次执行（全部轮次加子 Agent，推理与缓存分开）估价。
运行结束后「已处理」不再自动收起。
一次调用多个工具时，排在后面的工具把排队等待的时间也算成自己的耗时。
AI 用 project:edit 改过的文件没有计入「已编辑」。
全屏时顶栏左侧还留着红绿灯的空位；右上角设置按钮与下方聊天按钮没有对齐；上下文仪表多了一圈外框；「本轮改动」卡片行太高、合计的增删数字没有颜色。
文件树多选后右键，选择会被收回成单选。
en: Dragging the dividers between panes and above the bottom panel was janky, worse with a long chat and especially while the AI was running; all three dividers now also share one grab size and highlight width.

The cost estimate under an answer only counted the visible question and answer text, so a run with 100+ turns and sub-agents showed a few cents; it now prices the whole run (every turn plus sub-agents, with reasoning and cached tokens priced separately).
"Processed" no longer collapsed on its own after a run finished.
When several tools were called at once, a queued tool counted its waiting time as its own duration.
Files changed through project:edit were not counted as edited.

In fullscreen the top bar kept an empty gap for the window buttons; the settings button was not aligned with the chat button below it; the context gauge had an extra outer ring; rows in the round changes card were too tall and the totals lost their colors.
Right-clicking a multi-selection in the file tree collapsed it to a single file.

title.zh: 文件可切换只读与编辑，目标会自己接着推进
title.en: Switch files between read-only and edit, and goals keep going on their own

zh: 编辑器里每个文件都可以在只读和编辑之间切换（标签栏右侧的锁 / 笔图标）。被 .gitignore 忽略的文件默认只读，切到编辑后就能改；只读只挡你在编辑器里输入，不影响 AI 改文件。
目标还没完成、没有阻塞也没有暂停时，一轮结束后会自动接着推进下一轮，聊天里留一行说明，不会替你发消息；你停止、执行出错或排着自己的消息时不会自动续，连续 20 轮后自动暂停。
左侧「AI 改动」改名为「会话改动」并换了图标；在聊天里打开的单轮改动预览标题为「本轮改动」。
en: Every file in the editor can switch between read-only and edit mode (the lock / pencil icon on the right of the tab bar). Files ignored by .gitignore open read-only and become editable once you switch; read-only only blocks your typing in the editor and never blocks AI edits.

While a goal is not finished, blocked or paused, the next round starts automatically when a round ends, leaving a note in the chat instead of sending a message for you. It does not continue after you stop, after an error or while your own messages are queued, and it pauses after 20 rounds in a row.
The "AI Changes" panel on the left is now "Session Changes" with a new icon; the single-round preview opened from the chat is titled "Round Changes".

zh: 被 .gitignore 忽略的文件在编辑器里无法修改。
顶部的目标和计划两行没有对齐：目标图标带着底色、比文字高，计划标题显示成 plan:update。
en: Files ignored by .gitignore could not be edited in the editor.
The goal and plan rows at the top were misaligned: the goal icon had a background and sat above its text, and the plan was titled plan:update.

title.zh: 运行中往上翻聊天不再被拽回底部
title.en: Scrolling up in the chat during a run no longer snaps back to the bottom

zh: 更新或重开 Workbench 后，AI 运行时往上翻聊天会被一次次拽回底部，发新消息也不管用，要等内容足够长才恢复正常。
en: After updating or reopening Workbench, scrolling up in the chat while the AI was running kept snapping back to the bottom, even after sending a new message, until the conversation grew long enough.

title.zh: AI 改动实时跟着会话走，审批只在危险时打扰
title.en: AI changes follow the chat live, and approvals only interrupt for risky actions

zh: 左侧「AI 改动」跟右侧当前会话绑定：AI 一改完就出现，运行中实时更新，切换会话时跟着切换，并列出这个会话每一轮的改动。
AI 打开文件、查看改动，或你在聊天里点开某个文件改动时，左侧会自动切到对应的视图（AI 改动或文件树）并定位到那个文件。
Git 面板在 AI 或你改动文件后及时刷新，不用等这一轮结束。
en: The AI changes panel on the left follows the current chat: changes appear as soon as the AI makes them, update live during a run, switch with the chat, and list every round of that chat.
When the AI opens a file or reviews changes, or you open a file change from the chat, the left side switches to the matching view (AI changes or file tree) and locates the file.
The Git panel refreshes as soon as the AI or you change files, without waiting for the run to end.

zh: AI 写文件、改代码，以及删除或重命名能完整回滚的内容时，不再反复请求批准；只有删除整个文件夹、会丢掉未提交改动的 Git 操作、写到项目外等危险命令才会询问，而且每次都问。
你批准的危险命令会照常执行，不再批准之后仍被拦下。
AI 把对话历史里被省略的内容当成真实代码写进文件时，会在执行前被拦下，并提示它写出完整内容。
同一轮里先建目标再更新计划时，目标没有显示在顶部。
从聊天框里去掉当前文件后，输入框里对它的描述还留着。
AI 查看代码诊断时把语言写成 typescript，会什么都不检查。
AI 删除或重命名 UTF-16、GBK 等非 UTF-8 编码的文件后，回滚会改变文件的编码。
en: Writing files, editing code, and deleting or renaming anything that can be fully rolled back no longer asks for approval again and again. Only risky commands ask, such as deleting a whole folder, Git operations that discard uncommitted work, or writing outside the project, and they ask every time.
A risky command you approved now runs instead of being blocked after your approval.
If the AI writes the placeholder for content omitted from the chat history instead of real code, the edit is stopped before it runs and the AI is told to write the full content.
A goal created in the same round as a plan update did not show at the top.
After you removed the current file from the chat box, its description stayed in the input.
Code diagnostics checked nothing when the AI named the language "typescript".
Rolling back a deleted or renamed file in a non-UTF-8 encoding such as UTF-16 or GBK changed its encoding.

title.zh: AI 改代码更可靠，往上翻聊天不再被拽走
title.en: AI edits land reliably, and scrolling up in the chat stays put

zh: AI 的编辑失败时会告诉它该怎么改：语法错误带上文件、行、列和出错的那一行；要替换的文本找不到时指出最接近的位置和第一处不同（缩进、换行符、反斜杠多一层或少一层）；匹配到多处时列出每一处的行号。
AI 可以回滚自己的改动；如果文件在它改完之后又被你改过，回滚会被拒绝，不会覆盖你的内容。
en: When an AI edit fails, the AI learns how to fix it: syntax errors include the file, line, column and offending line; a missed match points to the closest spot and the first difference (indentation, line endings, an extra or missing backslash); several matches list every line.
The AI can roll back its own changes. If you edited the file after the AI changed it, the rollback is refused instead of overwriting your work.

zh: AI 在同一次编辑里改同一个文件的多处时，只有最后一处真正写进文件，前面的改动会悄悄丢失。
AI 按函数名替换整段代码时，遇到参数里带对象类型、或函数体里有带花括号的正则，会切错范围把代码改坏。
AI 用「新建」写一个已经存在的文件时会直接覆盖它；覆盖之后再回滚，还会把原文件删掉。
AI 一次读多个文件时，只要有一个文件行数不够，整批读取都会失败。
AI 查看代码诊断时会误报 Record、Set 等标准类型不存在；对整个文件夹做诊断时实际上没有检查任何文件。
AI 新建又删掉的文件会在 Git 状态里留下残项。
往上翻看聊天时，AI 调用工具、输出内容或一轮结束，会把视图拽回底部或这条消息的开头。
编辑失败时，聊天里的工具卡片显示「未知文件」。
en: When the AI changed several places in the same file in one edit, only the last change reached the file and the earlier ones were silently lost.
Replacing a whole function by name could cut at the wrong place and break the code when the function took an object-typed parameter or its body contained a regular expression with braces.
Writing an existing file in "create" mode overwrote it, and rolling that back deleted the original file.
Reading several files at once failed as a whole when any one of them had fewer lines than the requested range.
Code diagnostics falsely reported standard types such as Record and Set as missing, and diagnosing a whole folder did not actually check any file.
Files the AI created and then deleted left entries behind in the Git status.
While you scrolled up in the chat, AI tool calls, new output or the end of a run pulled the view back to the bottom or to the start of the message.
Failed edits showed "Unknown file" on their tool card in the chat.

title.zh: 子 Agent 卡片看得到完整输出，回答输出更平滑
title.en: Sub-agent cards show their full output, and answers stream more smoothly

zh: 子 Agent 卡片展开后显示它的完整输出：文字、思考和工具调用用与聊天页相同的样式呈现，运行中自动跟到最新内容。卡片标题收成一行，名字、类型和状态并排显示。
回答改为与 Desktop 相同的节奏逐字平滑输出，不再一阵一阵地跳；内容积压多时平稳加速、追上后平稳减速回平时的速度，新出现的字带淡入。
AI 讲解气泡更紧凑：顶部一行只放翻页、序号、标题和关闭按钮，只给正在看的那一段代码着色；点行号旁的序号标记可以显示或隐藏这一条讲解。
AI 可以一次打开多个文件，并把要你看的代码标成淡紫色的 AI 选区：选区锁在文件上，切换文件也还在，关掉这个文件才消失，AI 也可以一次取消。
en: Expanding a sub-agent card now shows its full output, with text, thinking and tool calls rendered the same way as in the chat, following the latest output while it runs. The card title fits on one line, with the name, type and status side by side.
Answers now stream out smoothly at the same pace as Desktop instead of arriving in bursts. When a lot of text piles up the speed eases up and then back down to the usual pace, and new text fades in.

The AI explanation bubble is more compact: a single header row with previous, next, position, title and a close button, and only the code being explained is highlighted. Click the numbered marker next to the line numbers to show or hide an explanation.

The AI can open several files at once and mark the code it wants you to look at as light purple AI selections. They stay on the file when you switch files, go away when you close that file, and the AI can clear them in one go.

zh: 第二个及之后派出的子 Agent 在运行时会显示成两张一模一样的卡片。
模型输出时界面发卡、风扇常转：聊天历史不再随每个字整份写一次存储，文件树、编辑区等页面其它部分也不再跟着回答重绘。
查看 AI 改动时左右两侧不再各显示一套：编辑区进入改动对比时左侧切到改动树，点「打开文件」回到普通编辑时左侧回到文件树，左侧切走时对比标签组也一并收起。去掉了标签栏上多余的「AI 改动」组名和返回按钮。
发送多行的提问后，回答输出时聊天不再停在原处、需要手动往下滚。
上下文用量在这一轮开始时就显示，不再要等回答结束；重新打开对话时直接显示上一次的用量。
子 Agent 读了几个大文件后会以「模型请求不变量校验失败」中断：现在大的工具结果会收成摘要，需要时 Agent 可以取回原文。
格式化文档不再把行内评论删掉、把讲解气泡和 AI 选区挤到文件开头，也不再在没装 Prettier 的 TS/JS 项目里删掉运算符和逗号两旁的空格；格式化只改动真正要变的地方，光标留在原处。
模型的思考内容不再整段重复一遍；一轮里后面步骤的思考也不再拼进前一步、工具卡上方的思考块里。
文件树里重命名时，输入框不再盖住上下两行和文件图标；按 Esc 取消重命名或收起搜索框时，也不再顺带把右侧的聊天面板收起来。
en: Sub-agents dispatched after the first one showed up as two identical cards while running.

The window lagged and the fans spun up while the model was answering: chat history is no longer written out in full for every token, and the rest of the page, such as the file tree and editor, no longer re-renders along with the answer.

Reviewing AI changes keeps both sides in step: the left panel shows the change tree while the editor compares, returns to the file tree when you choose Open file, and leaving the change tree closes the comparison tabs. The extra group label and back button are gone from the tab bar.
After sending a multi-line message, the chat now keeps following the answer instead of staying put until you scroll down.
Context usage shows as soon as a turn starts instead of only after the answer ends, and a reopened conversation shows its last usage right away.
Sub-agents no longer stop with a request invariant error after reading a few large files: large tool results are summarized and the agent can fetch the full text when it needs it.

Formatting a document no longer deletes inline comments, sends explanation bubbles and AI selections to the top of the file, or strips the spaces around operators and commas in TS/JS projects without Prettier. Only the text that needs to change is touched, and the cursor stays put.
The model's thinking no longer shows up twice, and a later step's thinking no longer gets merged into an earlier step's thinking block above its tool cards.
Renaming in the file tree no longer covers the rows above and below or the file icon, and pressing Esc to cancel a rename or close the search box no longer also collapses the chat panel.

title.zh: AI 在运行面板里跑命令、打开本机预览与读取问题
title.en: The AI runs commands in the Run panel, opens local previews, and reads problems

zh: AI 可以在底部「运行」面板里启动开发服务器、监听测试这类长驻命令，你能看到实时输出、随时停止；它会等服务就绪再继续，也会读输出判断有没有报错。可能改动项目的命令会先请你确认，破坏性命令直接拒绝。
开发服务器起来后，AI 可以把本机地址直接在 Workbench 内置浏览器里打开给你看；没开内置浏览器时用系统浏览器。
AI 可以读取编辑器报告的类型错误等问题，并把出问题的位置和「问题」面板打开给你看。
en: The AI can start long-running commands such as a dev server or tests in watch mode in the bottom Run panel, where you see the live output and can stop them. It waits for the server to be ready and reads the output to spot errors. Commands that may change the project ask you first, and destructive commands are refused.
Once a dev server is up, the AI can open its local address in Workbench's built-in browser, or in your system browser when the built-in one is off.
The AI can read the problems the editor reports, such as type errors, and show you the location and the Problems panel.

title.zh: AI 操作编辑器、代码讲解气泡与每一轮的 AI 改动
title.en: The AI works the editor, explains code in place, and shows every run's changes

zh: AI 可以直接操作编辑器：打开文件并定位到某一行或选中一段代码、在文件树里定位文件、打开某个文件的 Git 改动对比，也能读取你当前打开的文件和选中的代码。
AI 讲解代码时会把讲解气泡钉在对应代码旁边，多处讲解连成一条路线；气泡上可以上一条、下一条、收起或结束讲解，行号旁的标记可以随时展开某一处。
左侧新增「AI 改动」：按轮列出 AI 每一轮改过的文件，每轮一棵文件树；点开文件在编辑区的独立标签组里只读查看整份文件，新增的行为绿色、删除的行为红色。
一轮 AI 运行改了文件时，结束后会自动打开这一轮的改动（可在设置中关闭）；回答末尾改动卡的「审核」也会打开这里。停止或失败的一轮同样会记录改动。
en: The AI can now work the editor: open a file at a line or select a block of code, reveal a file in the file tree, open a file's Git diff, and read the file and selection you are looking at.

When the AI explains code, it pins explanation bubbles next to the code and links them into a walkthrough. Each bubble has previous, next, collapse, and end controls, and markers next to the line numbers expand any stop.

A new AI Changes view on the left lists the files each AI run changed, one file tree per run. Open a file to see the whole file read-only in its own editor tab group, with added lines in green and removed lines in red.

When a run changes files, its changes open automatically afterwards (you can turn this off in Settings), and the Review button on an answer's change card opens the same view. Runs that were stopped or failed record their changes too.

title.zh: 回答里的路径可点开、运行状态与估算费用
title.en: Clickable answer paths, run status, and cost estimates

zh: 运行中，状态行会显示模型正在做什么：思考到了哪个阶段，或正在执行哪个工具。
回答末尾会显示这一轮的估算费用（当前模型在价格表中有定价时）。
切换到别的对话再回来，会回到上次看到的位置。
输入框里的附件可以点击打开。
en: While a run is in progress, the status line shows what the model is doing: its current thinking stage or the tool it is running.
Answers now end with an estimated cost for the turn when the current model has a listed price.
Each conversation keeps its scroll position when you switch away and come back.
Attachments in the input box can be clicked to open.

zh: 回答里的文件路径现在可以点击：项目里的文件在编辑器中打开，项目外的文件用系统默认程序打开；回答末尾列出的文件也可以直接打开或在访达中显示。
en: File paths in answers are now clickable: project files open in the editor and files outside the project open with the system default app. Files listed at the end of an answer can be opened or shown in Finder.

title.zh: 本轮改动、目标模式与执行计划
title.en: Run changes, goal mode, and execution plans

zh: 每一轮回答末尾会列出这一轮改动过的文件和增删行数，可以展开查看逐行差异，也可以在编辑器中打开；逐行差异保存在本机数据目录，不占浏览器存储。
目标模式正式可用：开启后按你的消息建立目标，输入框上方的目标卡可以暂停、继续或移除目标。
模型可以为较长的任务建立并推进执行计划，进度显示在输入框上方。
已完成的回答会把处理过程收进「已处理」并显示耗时；停止或失败的回答末尾会标出状态。
en: Each answer now ends with the files that run changed and their added and removed lines; expand a file for a line-by-line diff or open it in the editor. The diffs are kept in the local data folder, not in browser storage.
Goal mode now works end to end: it sets a goal from your message, and the goal card above the input box lets you pause, continue, or remove it.
The model can set up and advance an execution plan for longer tasks, with progress shown above the input box.
Finished answers fold their work into a processed summary with the run time, and stopped or failed answers show their status at the end.

zh: 点「+」新建对话后，对话面板不再一直停在加载中。
en: Clicking + to start a new conversation no longer leaves the chat panel stuck loading.

title.zh: 运行中引导、会话回溯与聊天体验对齐
title.en: Run guidance, conversation rewind, and chat parity

zh: 运行中发送的消息会作为引导注入当前这一轮并显示引导进度，也可以选择本轮结束后再发送。
支持回溯到任意一条消息之前，可同时把项目文件恢复到那一轮开始前的状态。
在浏览器中拾取的页面元素会出现在输入框里，随消息一起交给模型。
主 Agent 派出子 Agent 时，可以指定当前模型厂商下已配置的任意模型；不指定时沿用主模型。
en: Messages sent while a run is in progress now reach the current run as guidance with visible progress; you can also choose to send after the run ends.
You can rewind the conversation to before any message, optionally restoring project files to how they were when that turn started.
Page elements picked in the browser now appear in the input box and are sent to the model with your message.
When the main agent dispatches a sub-agent, it can pick any configured model from the current provider; otherwise the sub-agent uses the main model.

zh: 从「提交」切回文件面板时，文件树顶部不再出现空白。
发出新一轮消息后，运行状态显示在新消息下方，不再先出现在上一轮回复上方。
子 Agent 不再一派发就报「模型 selection.provider 必须显式提供」。
中止或失败后再发的消息会接着那一轮继续；停止后，排队的消息不再自动发出。
回答中的文件路径和改动卡可以直接在编辑器中打开；单条消息渲染出错时只影响这一条。
en: The file tree no longer shows a blank top after switching back from the Commit view.
After you send a new message, the run status appears below it instead of above it on the previous reply.
Sub-agents no longer fail on dispatch with a missing model provider error.
A message sent after a stopped or failed run now continues that run, and queued messages are no longer sent automatically after you stop.
File paths and change cards in answers open in the editor, and a message that fails to render no longer breaks the whole conversation.

title.zh: 聊天能力对齐与代码块体验修复
title.en: Chat parity and code block fixes

zh: 工作台聊天支持操作审批、权限设置与子 Agent，与 Desktop 保持一致。
en: Workbench chat now supports action approvals, permission settings, and sub-agents, matching Desktop.

zh: 结构面板完整列出项目中的全部 Velar 源文件；运行档位恢复完整三档；状态栏更新进度改为与主题一致的轻量样式。
主题强调色只有一个来源，弹出菜单与主界面颜色保持一致。
回复输出过程中代码块不再反复刷新：点开的代码块保持展开，短代码块直接完整显示，鼠标停在代码块上页面可正常滚动。
模型长时间思考时显示「思考中」，只有真正断网重试时才显示「重连中」。
en: The structure panel now lists every Velar source file in the project, all three run profiles are available again, and the status-bar update progress uses a light, theme-matched style.
The theme accent now has a single source, so popovers match the main window.
Code blocks no longer refresh repeatedly while a reply streams: expanded blocks stay open, short blocks are shown in full, and the page scrolls normally over code blocks.
Long model pauses now show “Thinking”; “Reconnecting” only appears when a real network retry happens.

title.zh: Windows 发布可靠性修复
title.en: Windows release reliability fix

zh: 让本地发布工作流校验同时兼容 LF 与 CRLF 检出，确保 Windows 原生发布门禁稳定通过。
en: Made local release-workflow verification accept both LF and CRLF checkouts so the native Windows release gate remains deterministic.

title.zh: 游戏预览鼠标锁定修复
title.en: Pointer lock fix for game previews

zh: 修复 OpenVoxel 等游戏预览点击后无法锁定鼠标的问题，恢复依赖鼠标锁定的视角转向和键盘移动。
en: Fixed pointer lock after clicking game previews such as OpenVoxel, restoring mouse look and keyboard movement that depend on pointer lock.

title.zh: 统一且可靠的侧栏聊天
title.en: Unified and reliable sidebar chat

zh: 通过 Platform UI 与 Desktop 共用聊天组件和交互逻辑，同时保留 Workbench 专属组合边界。
en: Shared chat components and interaction logic with Desktop through Platform UI while preserving Workbench-specific composition.

zh: 将聊天内容限制在可调整宽度的侧栏内，并恢复稳定滚动、导航、紧凑代码块与更新进度显示。
让终止状态可靠收敛，并在取消运行时终止由 Workbench 持有的命令进程。
en: Kept chat content within the resizable sidebar and restored stable scrolling, navigation, compact code blocks, and update progress.
Made stop settlement deterministic and terminated Workbench-owned command processes when a run was cancelled.

title.zh: 跨平台语言服务与发布修复
title.en: Cross-platform language service and release fixes

zh: 规范化 Windows LSP 文件 URI，使诊断可靠映射回已打开的文档。
保持 macOS 发布路径检查确定，并继续在各原生平台独立发布。
en: Canonicalized Windows LSP file URIs so diagnostics map back to open documents reliably.
Kept macOS release path checks deterministic and preserved independent native-platform publication.

title.zh: Platform 0.6.34 兼容升级
title.en: Platform 0.6.34 compatibility update

zh: 升级 System 至 1.1.16，并将直接与传递 Platform 依赖锁定到对应正式版本。
通过本地签名和公证链路发布 macOS arm64 候选。
en: Updated System to 1.1.16 and locked direct and transitive Platform dependencies to their corresponding published versions.
Published the macOS arm64 candidate through the local signing and notarization path.

title.zh: Platform 0.6.32 兼容升级
title.en: Platform 0.6.32 compatibility update

zh: 将全部直接 Platform 包升级到 Platform 0.6.32 发布版本，并保持精确不可变依赖。
通过本地 Mac 签名和公证链路发布 macOS arm64 候选。
en: Updated every direct Platform package to the Platform 0.6.32 release while retaining exact immutable dependencies.
Published the macOS arm64 candidate through the local Mac signing and notarization path.

title.zh: 按原生平台独立发布
title.en: Independent native-platform releases

zh: macOS、Windows 与 Linux 的打包结果现在可以独立发布。
en: macOS, Windows, and Linux packaging results can now be published independently.

zh: 单个平台失败或不可用不再阻塞已成功平台生成签名候选目录。
后续平台运行会追加已验证资产，而不会替换先前发布的下载。
en: A failed or unavailable platform no longer blocks successful platforms from producing a signed candidate catalog.
Later platform runs append verified assets without replacing previously published downloads.

title.zh: 菜单外观与焦点修复
title.en: Menu appearance and focus fixes

zh: 统一分支选择菜单在普通与懒加载状态下的边框、背景和阴影。
修复搜索区域与窗口拖拽冲突，并让浮层正确自动聚焦和恢复焦点。
en: Unified branch-menu borders, backgrounds, and shadows across normal and lazy-loaded states.
Fixed conflicts with window dragging and restored correct autofocus and focus return for overlays.

title.zh: 工具安全与搜索性能
title.en: Tool safety and search performance

zh: 对齐 Platform 工具安全边界，强化浏览器脚本、Windows 命令路径与破坏性命令识别。
加强 Office 预览净化和媒体路径校验，避免不可信内容进入预览。
将路径提示改为线性扫描，并收紧跨平台路径、模型别名和工具结果解析。
en: Aligned Platform tool-safety boundaries for browser scripts, Windows command paths, and destructive-command detection.
Hardened Office preview sanitization and media-path validation against untrusted content.
Moved path suggestions to linear scanning and tightened cross-platform path, model-alias, and tool-result parsing.

title.zh: 托管模型目录同步
title.en: Managed model catalog synchronization

zh: 为模型配置和托管模型目录加入可订阅更新，使已打开的界面在刷新后立即同步。
en: Added subscriptions for model configuration and managed catalogs so open interfaces update immediately after refresh.

zh: 稳定显示 VelarOS 与 VelarOS-Dev，并明确标记暂时不可用的服务。
刷新期间保留最后一次成功快照，并拒绝过期界面状态提交的模型选择。
en: Stabilized VelarOS and VelarOS-Dev display names and clearly marked temporarily unavailable services.
Kept the last successful snapshot during refresh and rejected model selections submitted from stale interface state.

title.zh: 可信发布与启动体积门禁
title.en: Trusted releases and startup budgets

zh: 重构更新发布事务，记录原生平台、架构、签名状态和验证证据，并在 completion 前验证远端字节与签名目录。
新增 main、renderer 及首屏资源体积预算，防止启动成本回归。
en: Reworked the update transaction to record native platform, architecture, signature state, and evidence, then verify remote bytes and the signed catalog before completion.
Added size budgets for main, renderer, and startup resources to prevent startup-cost regressions.

zh: 升级共享 Platform 执行栈，修正取消语义并收窄语言操作的运行时依赖边界。
en: Updated the shared Platform execution stack, corrected cancellation semantics, and narrowed language-operation runtime dependencies.

title.zh: 预览交互与共享执行栈
title.en: Preview interactions and shared execution

zh: 图片预览加入缩放、适应窗口、快捷键和放大后拖动。
Agent 与行内补全接入共享执行及模型请求栈，同时保留真实工具 schema 和调用身份。
en: Added zoom controls, fit-to-window, shortcuts, and panning for enlarged image previews.
Moved Agent execution and inline completion onto shared execution and model-request stacks while preserving real tool schemas and call identity.

zh: 改进终端输出高亮和控制序列处理，使内容与工具面板样式保持一致。
en: Improved terminal highlighting and control-sequence handling so output remains consistent with tool-panel styling.
